name: GPU-Based Voxel Carving with Systematic Occlusion Handling
aliases: Visual Hull Carving with Occlusion Maps
Voxel Carving Kernel with Systematic Occlusion Handling
Voxel Carving with Systematic Occlusion Handling
definition: The method computes the minimal visual hull of multiple people in real-time in the presence of static occlusions by projecting voxels into silhouette images and occlusion maps on the GPU.
summary: GPU-Based Voxel Carving with Systematic Occlusion Handling computes minimal visual hulls in real-time by preserving voxels occluded by static background objects, unlike standard methods that incorrectly remove them.
